data.cultural_impact: The name Pradyumn holds a significant cultural impact in Hinduism as it is reminiscent of the sun god, Surya. In Hindu mythology, the sun is considered a powerful symbol of life, energy, and creativity. The name Pradyumn embodies the brightness, power, and illumination associated with the sun.
data.spiritual_significance: Pradyumn holds spiritual significance as it symbolizes the inner light of knowledge and wisdom that shines forth from an individual. It represents the pursuit of knowledge and understanding, as well as the enlightenment that comes with gaining that knowledge. The name is a reminder to seek the inner light and guidance that comes from within, just like the sun provides light to the world.

historical_references.reference: Pradyumna is the eldest son of Krishna and Rukmini. He is the grandson of Vasudeva and Devaki, and is named after the god Pradyumna, who was an incarnation of Vishnu.
Another Pradyumna, a king of the Sunga Dynasty (2nd century BCE), is believed to have ruled over Magadha. He succeeded his father Agnimitra and was succeeded by his son Vasumitra.
